newsitem.title: THAILAND: NPC gives capital spending breakdown.
newsitem.headline: NPC gives capital spending breakdown.

text.p: Thai chemical group National Petrochemical Plc said on Tuesday it had spent 1.98 billion baht ($76 million) of a recent 2.31 billion baht capital increase on boosting output and investing in subsidiaries.

The group told the Stock Exchange of Thailand that it had spent 1.02 billion baht on a 3.5 billion baht project to boost annual production of ethylene and propylene by 108,000 metric tonnes to 528,000 metric tonnes.

In addition, NPC said it had spent an additional 375 million baht on a 440 million baht project to boost its electricity generating output from its Small Power Producing project in Rayong by 33 megawatts.

Investment in subsidiaries or affiliates, including Thai Tank Terminal Co Ltd, Thai Olefins Co Ltd, National Fertiliser Co Ltd, and PTT Petrochemicals Co Ltd, accounted for a further 585 million baht, the company said.
The balance of 330 million baht will be used as working capital, the statement said.
